name: XmlMaps
description: Represents the collection of XmlMap objects that have been added to a workbook.
example:
Sub AddXmlMap()
 Dim strSchemaLocation As String

 strSchemaLocation = "https://example.microsoft.com/schemas/CustomerData.xsd"
 ActiveWorkbook.XmlMaps.Add strSchemaLocation, "Root"
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Schema As String, [RootElementName As Variant]) As XmlMap
methods.description: Adds an XML map to the specified workbook.

parameters.name: Schema
parameters.description: The schema to be added as an XML map. The string can be a path to a schema file, or the schema itself. The path can be specified in the Universal Naming Convention (UNC) or Uniform Resource Locator (URL) format.

parameters.name: RootElementName
parameters.description: The name of the root element. This argument can be ignored if the schema contains only one root element.
